detected_by: driver.sh launch exit 1 with 'Running /home/todd/.cache/codex-rf-picker/debug/codex-desktop' present in the tauri-dev log
impact: run-desktop driver.sh cannot detect app readiness when CARGO_TARGET_DIR is exported per the tranche build rule. Its probe is pgrep -f 'target/debug/codex' (driver.sh:52,111), but the binary then lives at $CARGO_TARGET_DIR/debug/codex-desktop, which contains no 'target/debug/codex' substring. launch reports 'Timed out waiting for launch' while the app is actually up and serving.
resolution: relaunched with env -u CARGO_TARGET_DIR so cargo used the default apps/desktop/src-tauri/target; that path is on / (472G free), not the 40G /tmp tmpfs, so the build rule's actual hazard was not reintroduced
